title: Subcontractor work lacks acceptance evidence

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: We send partners addresses and symptoms by message. Some return detailed reports; others only say done. One replaced a part with branch permission, but head office refused to pay. Assignment time was mistaken for an agreed arrival time during another complaint.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: Eight internal staff plus regional external service partners.

discriminating_questions.question: Who may approve additional cost?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Head office, not the branch contact.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: Separate site access from spending authority.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: If detailed instructions were acknowledged and repeatedly ignored, partner performance management may be needed beyond software.

discriminating_questions.question: Do we record acceptance and appointment times?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: What evidence is mandatory?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Will partners install our application?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Most will use a simple phone page but resist another account workflow.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Delegated work lacks explicit scope, authority, milestones and a completion contract.
counterexample: If detailed instructions were acknowledged and repeatedly ignored, partner performance management may be needed beyond software.
minimum_evidence: A simulated partner invoice includes an unapproved replacement.
A simulated assignment contains no spending limit.
A simulated report says only done.
process_intervention: Send a concise work order with scope, escalation contact and evidence requirements; separate technical completion from customer acceptance.
automation_candidate: Provide authenticated, job-scoped mobile reporting; record acceptance, agreed window, actual arrival, parts and approval requests.
unknowns: Partner access, payout terms and required evidence must be agreed contractually.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: External partner access and spend authorization need separate engineering.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
